commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src conda run -n autodrift python -m autodrift.input_observability_audit --env-config configs/m91c_raw_wheel_minimum_profile.json --episodes 40 --seed 9340 --policy heuristic --horizon-steps 15 --sample-stride 3 --max-samples 1000 --ridge 0.1 --history-windows 1,10,25,50,100 --run-dir runs/m91e_history_window_observability_seed9340
commands.name: history_window_observability_probe

decision_rule: Before sensor ablations or PPO profile comparisons, test whether command-response history windows improve future envelope prediction over current-frame features.
failure_criteria: observability script cannot build history-window feature sets
profile_gain_summary.csv omits the history window dimension
results are used to tune PPO before a stable recipe is frozen
hypothesis: Self-identification evidence should strengthen when the probe receives past commands and sensed responses, especially for braking and yaw authority targets.
success_criteria: history-window probes run without changing PPO or reward settings
history windows improve at least one self-ID target over current frame
P1 raw wheel history is compared against P0 no-wheel history at identical windows
decision states whether to proceed to minimum-set sensor ablations
